text: When they gathered up what was left over, they filled seven large baskets with the broken pieces.
There was far more at the end than there had been at the start.
And the numbers were the proof this was no retelling: five loaves had left twelve baskets the first time; seven loaves left seven this time.
Later Jesus made the disciples count both feedings — twelve baskets, then seven — so they could never blur the two into one.
He wanted both of them remembered.
